svg.text: Where M5 returns space to the contents
Actual CAD sections at the same scale. Blue = body/guide; orange = cap; green = central storage space.
At the catches — section Z=180 mm
Above the catches — section Z=220 mm
At the catches — section Z=180 mm
Above the catches — section Z=220 mm
Above the catches, the middle passage widens from 56.9 to 66.1 mm; full 78 mm guidance remains.
The catch-level bottleneck stays 56.9 mm. M5 recovers room beyond it; larger objects still must pass the mouth.
M5 is flat at 77 mm: the previous maximum is unchanged, but its broad sides are 2 mm wider than M4.
